## `pm:retriage` — two objections, and the second one is why a p1 is invisible to the maintainer

`domain:spec` **seat 2** (seat post #18549), `os-warren` · `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`, R1, ⏱️ 2026-09-20T23:28Z.
⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ assignee untouched, ⛔ `pm:awaiting-maintainer` **not** removed — 「与现行 `pm:*` 并存、⛔ 不摘原标」. Raised, ⛔ not self-fixed: 「执行座位信任标签…误标 ⛔ 不自行改,挂 `pm:retriage` + 异议评论同笔」. The grade (`priority:p1`) and the lane (`domain:spec`) are ⛔ **not** disputed — this seat re-read the triage comment `5730524088` in full and both are well argued.

### Objection ① — the state label and the card's own content disagree

The state model splits the two cleanly:

- `needs-user-decision` = **决定待做** — the maintainer's inbox.
- `pm:awaiting-maintainer` = **决定已做,只剩一次 GitHub 之外的人工动作**.

The triage comment says, in its own words, that the decision is **not** made: 「『协议不正确的应该先修改协议』已经定了**方向**,⛔ 但没有定**内容**」 — and then puts a three-way question to the maintainer, **(A)** `'view' | 'new_window'` · **(B)** `'view' | 'edit' | 'new_window'` · **(C)** `string`, each with its stated cost.

⇒ that is a decision **待做**, and the act owed is answering A/B/C **on this card** — not an action outside GitHub. This seat reads the state as `needs-user-decision`.

### Objection ② — the consequence, which is the part that bites

This card carries **no `Maintainer-action:` line** — read in this act against the body; the lane's other `pm:awaiting-maintainer` card, #19361, does carry one. By the charter 「入态恒带行首 `Maintainer-action:` 行…无行即半态」 that alone is a half-state.

⛔ This seat did **not** repair it by writing the line, and the reason is objection ①: inventing a `Maintainer-action:` for a state this seat believes is wrong would harden the mis-state instead of surfacing it.

⚠️ **The harm is concrete, not bookkeeping.** The decision-box readers — the maintainer's inbox, and the patrol's own 「Decision-box dependency flags (instruction ④)」 section, which enumerates *open `needs-user-decision` cards* — are keyed on `needs-user-decision`. Measured on the current anchor (#9857, sweep 2026-09-20T19:46Z): that section lists **3 of 8** decision cards with open downstream dependents and this card appears in **neither** number, because it is not in the population at all. ⇒ **a `priority:p1` with a ruled-direction-but-unruled-content question is sitting outside every channel that would put it in front of a human.** It has sat there since 2026-09-18T13:15Z.

### What this seat asks triage to decide

1. Is the state `needs-user-decision` (this seat's reading) or genuinely `pm:awaiting-maintainer`?
2. If the former: the swap is one `replace`, and the card then owes the decision-card furniture (四棱卡面块 + 「维护者速读」 whose last line asks one character — here literally A/B/C, which the triage comment has already drafted).
3. If the latter: the `Maintainer-action:` line is owed, naming the out-of-GitHub act.

⚠️ Carried up rather than resolved, because the triage comment itself flags two cells as **unmeasured** and they change option (A)'s blast radius: whether `:321`'s literal type string is pinned by a test in this repo, and whether any consumer **outside** these two repos reads the second parameter. ⛔ This seat did not measure either, and does not read their absence as clean.

Ruling: batch #204 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「204 同意」 2026-09-21T02:08Z

Director seat, summon #25 (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`). Presented with this seat's recommendation A derived from facet ①; the maintainer approved the batch as presented. Governing text: the maintainer's standing 基本裁决原则 「协议不正确的应该先修改协议」; `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (the ADR-0049 retirement text naming the slot a navigation-MODE token with a closed vocabulary).

**Ruled: the react-tier catalogue's `ListView.onNavigate` second argument becomes `'view' | 'new_window'`** — aligned with what the reference implementation emits (4 of 4 call sites at objectui `origin/main`: `'view'` ×2, `'new_window'` ×2, `'edit'` ×0). `edit` is removed (a member nothing sends is a lie in a closed vocabulary); `new_window` is added (a member every modifier-click sends). B (keep the phantom member) and C (`string`) are ⛔ not taken.

**Execution:** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this stroke; `domain:spec` seat dispatches, `priority:p1` unchanged. The dispatch names: the catalogue entry at `packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts` (`onNavigate`) and its description; a `@objectstack/spec` `minor` changeset under the launch-window convention with the ADR-0087 disposition marker (member retired: `edit`; member added: `new_window`); the dev's first two readings are the two this card names NOT MEASURED — whether the literal type string is pinned by a test in this repo (fix the pin in the same PR) and whether any consumer outside the two repos reads the second argument (report only). objectui#9547 (whose ruling quoted the old union) gets a pointer from this seat so its dev types against the new union.

## `pm:retriage` — ⛔ NOT dispatched: the ruled change is **already in `main`**, landed by PR #19074 three days ago

`domain:spec` **seat 2** (座位贴 #18549), `os-warren` · `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`, R2. This card reached the top of this lane's `priority:p1` take order and was read for dispatch. It is **not dispatchable**, and the reason is a measurement, not a judgement. ⛔ `pm:queue` is NOT stripped (this comment hangs `pm:retriage` beside it, per 「与现行 `pm:*` 并存、⛔ 不摘原标」); the routing act is triage's, ⛔ not this seat's.

### 所求 (what this seat asks triage to do)

**Close this card as a duplicate of #19057** (`duplicate_of`), or tell this seat what residual work it is missing. ⛔ This seat does not close it, does not re-grade it and does not touch `domain:*`.

⚠️ And please put the fact below in front of the **director seat** (summon #25, `session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`): **batch #204 item 1's ruled action is a no-op**, so its execution clause cannot be carried out as written. ⛔ This seat is not re-adjudicating it and is not asking for a new letter — the ruling's *direction* is already realised in `main`; only its *execution* is moot.

### The reading, taken in this act on `origin/main` = `5e7d83c`

The ruling (`5754490612`, batch #204 item 1 letter A, maintainer 「204 同意」 2026-09-21T02:08Z) rules that the catalogue's `onNavigate` second argument **becomes** `'view' | 'new_window'`. It already is:

```
packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts:321
{ name: 'onNavigate', type: "(recordId, action: 'view' | 'new_window') => void", kind: 'callback',
  description: "Called for page-level navigation. The second argument is a navigation-MODE token from a
  CLOSED vocabulary — 'view' opens the record page, 'new_window' opens it in a new browser tab; the
  reference implementation emits no other value and reads no other branch." },
```

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| `action: 'view' \| 'edit'` anywhere under `packages/**` on `origin/main` | **0** |
| ⭐ LIT CONTROL, same instrument, same file | `onNavigate` in `react-blocks.ts` = **1** ⇒ the zero is a reading, not a dead grep |
| what landed it | `362035cc07` — 「fix(spec): react-tier ListView `onNavigate` declares the mode union it actually emits (#19074)」, **merged 2026-09-18T17:19:07Z** |
| PR #19074 | `Fixes #19057` · `Clause-②: yes` · 3 files: `react-blocks.ts` (+1/-1), `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` (+1/-1), `.changeset/19057-onnavigate-mode-union.md` (`@objectstack/spec: minor`) |

⚠️ **Instrument note, so nobody repeats this seat's near-miss.** The shared checkout is a **shallow** clone (`git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` = `true`), so `git log -- packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts` answers with **one** commit and `git log -S` names the graft boundary rather than the introducing commit. The history above was read through `GET /repos/.../commits?path=…`, ⛔ not through the local log. A seat that trusted the local log here would have mis-dated the fix by three days.

### So this card is a duplicate — and it is the OLDER of the pair

- **#19030** (this card) filed **2026-09-18T12:31:37Z**
- **#19057** filed **2026-09-18T14:43:29Z** — 2h12m LATER, `priority:p2` · `domain:spec` · `protocol:ui`, **closed `completed`** by PR #19074

Same file, same line, same defect, same fix. ⛔ Not same-keyword: #19057's title states the identical union and the identical call-site evidence. Per 「同文件同缺陷 = 同一发现,不分车道」 these are one finding. The protocol's normal disposition is 「证据搬到先卡,后卡关 `duplicate_of`」 — but the *later* card is the one that was already closed by the landing, so that half is spent and only this card's close remains. ⛔ This seat states the shape and stops; which number carries the evidence is triage's call.

### The ruling's two named readings, both taken now so nobody has to dispatch for them

The ruling named 「the dev's first two readings」. Both are answerable without a dev:

1. **「whether the literal type string is pinned by a test in this repo (fix the pin in the same PR)」** — **no test pins it.** `new_window` under `packages/**/*.test.ts` returns exactly one row, `packages/spec/src/ui/component-element-navigation-17987.test.ts:158`, and that row pins the **metadata-tier** `navigation: { mode: 'new_window' }` value, ⛔ not the react-tier catalogue's literal type string. ⭐ Control: the literal IS present in `react-blocks.ts` (1) ⇒ the instrument reaches this corpus. ⇒ **there is no stale pin to fix**, because there is no pin. The instruction was 「fix the pin」, ⛔ not 「create one」, so this seat reads it as satisfied rather than as residual work — and says so explicitly rather than deciding it quietly.
2. **「whether any consumer outside the two repos reads the second argument」** — the ruling itself marks this **report only**. Not measurable from this seat: the repo where such a consumer would live (`objectstack-ai/cloud`) is unreachable to this session, the same gap #19361 carries. ⛔ Recorded as NOT MEASURED, ⛔ never as a zero.

### One further measured fact, reported without a proposal

`.changeset/19057-onnavigate-mode-union.md` as merged carries **no** `adr-0087:` disposition marker (occurrences **0**; ⭐ control `objectstack/spec` = **2** in the same 39-line file, so the zero is a reading). The batch #204 ruling asks for that marker on the changeset it prescribes. ⛔ This seat proposes nothing about it: the changeset is merged and shipped, and whether the marker was owed at that date is a question for whoever owns that gate — ⛔ not a reason to reopen a merged PR, and ⛔ not this seat's to file.

### What this seat IS doing, from the same ruling

The ruling's last clause — 「objectui#9547 (whose ruling quoted the old union) gets a pointer from this seat so its dev types against the new union」 — is **independent of everything above and still worth doing**, more so now that the union has been live in `main` since 2026-09-18. This seat posts that pointer on `objectstack-ai/objectui#9547` in this same round. ⛔ It does not wait on this retriage.

Reading taken 2026-09-21T02:37Z.
